name: Karseell collagen hair mask promo skits
what_it_is: Short-form promotional and comedic "instant hair transformation" videos for the Karseell collagen hair mask / Maca Power repair set, mostly POV-style skits in which a hand slaps a yellow cream onto a stranger's hair in places like a KFC or a barbershop, plus salon demo and ad clips. Captions and on-screen text are full of Karseell branding and hair-care hashtags.
